title: Moving an archive with a check on the contents
description: Usernames, notes and attachments come across with a list of the gaps and the unsupported fields.

blocks.text: A person wants to leave the old service, but moving hundreds of entries by hand holds them back. The narrow job is to carry an archive between particular compatible formats and to show what could not be processed. A count of entries is not enough for that.

quote.text: I have used this one for years and have tried to switch because their price keeps going up and up now it’s 50 bucks a year. Seems crazy for a password keeper. They make it virtually impossible to switch. Don’t get started.

blocks.text: Support particular source formats, show a preliminary parse and a report after the move. Leave a way to reconcile the attachments and the fields.
Do not promise a universal converter for any manager. Protecting temporary files and verifying the import are a required part of the product itself.
